name: Improved Error Reporting
description: Windows MDM settings in the Improved Error Reporting category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Stop reporting error messages (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether the application reports error messages.

If you enable this policy, error messages will not be reported.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, error messages will be reported.

properties.name: Stop reporting non-critical errors (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether the application reports non-critical errors.

If you enable this policy, non-critical errors will not be reported.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, non-critical errors will be reported.
